call_101_victim_upi_fraud.wav.transcript: Hello? Please, you have to help me. Someone has taken money from my account. I got a call this morning from a man who said he was from the bank. He told me my account was under digital arrest. He said I would be jailed if I did not cooperate. He asked me to share the one time password. I shared it. Two minutes later, two lakh forty five thousand rupees was gone. Please freeze my account. I am begging you.

call_102_informant_ransomware_tip.wav.transcript: Listen, I cannot talk for long. I work as a contract system administrator. A group is planning a ransomware attack on the municipal server. The malware is already inside the backup network. They are asking for fifty lakh rupees in crypto. You need to check the backup systems tonight. I will send proof to the secure email address on your website. Please do not call this number again.

call_103_angry_account_compromise.wav.transcript: What the hell is going on? My entire savings account has been wiped out. I have been calling your helpline for two hours. Someone cloned my SIM card and bypassed the authentication. They transferred nine lakh rupees in four transactions. I want the cyber cell head on the phone right now. And I want a written complaint number before I hang up.

call_104_suspected_vishing_caller.wav.transcript: Good morning, officer. I am calling from the Reserve Bank compliance department. We have detected suspicious activity on accounts in your jurisdiction. I need you to verify the nodal officer credentials and share the secure access token for the banking portal. This is a time sensitive audit. Please do not disconnect the call.

call_105_elderly_digital_arrest.wav.transcript: Officer, I am seventy two years old and I live alone. This afternoon I received a video call. The man was wearing a police uniform. He said my Aadhaar card was linked to a money laundering case, and that a warrant had been issued. He said I was under digital arrest and could not tell anyone. He made me transfer one lakh eighty thousand rupees as a verification deposit. Then he demanded five lakh more. I am scared. Please tell me what to do.

call_106_mule_account_recruiter.wav.transcript: Hey, listen. I have a simple job for you. You do not have to do anything illegal. Just open a current account and give me the debit card and the SIM card. I will pay you five thousand rupees every month. The money that comes in is from a gaming company. Nothing will happen to you. Nobody checks these accounts. Are you interested or not?
